## Medifast to Announce Financial Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026


10/14/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/637190801/files/doc_news/Medifast-to-Announce-Financial-Results-for-the-Third-Quarter-Ended-September-30-2026-2026.pdf)


BALTIMORE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Medifast](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.medifastinc.com%2F&esheet=54621996&newsitemid=20261014815135&lan=en-US&anchor=Medifast&index=1&md5=2941e9125f2fd5b6303033931005667c) (NYSE: MED), the metabolic health and wellness company known for its science-backed comprehensive metabolic health system, Trilivy™, will announce financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, October 26, 2026, before market open. The Company will host a conference call to discuss the results with additional comments and details. Company participants will be Nick Johnson, Chief Executive Officer, and Jim Maloney, Chief Financial Officer.


The conference call is scheduled to begin at 8:30 a.m. ET on October 26, 2026. The call will be broadcast live over the Internet, hosted on the Investor Relations section of Medifast's website at[www.MedifastInc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.medifastinc.com%2F&esheet=54621996&newsitemid=20261014815135&lan=en-US&anchor=www.MedifastInc.com&index=2&md5=7a34a58a92f2df53110fe4b128618fcd) or directly at[https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1777297&tp_key=e45ccefd73](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fviavid.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1777297%26tp_key%3De45ccefd73__%3B%21%21BJC1RqioiA%219FfBBnE1P3DymFlx4CsjDnYs8CG30OnFge_GceVVE8xjkoDCOFXTzcpE2WW_Ca-VnOywjOdcjq4yYsqPZqr3jR8%24&esheet=54621996&newsitemid=20261014815135&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fviavid.webcasts.com%2Fstarthere.jsp%3Fei%3D1777297%26amp%3Btp_key%3De45ccefd73&index=3&md5=c7a3461910d347460298327e74d0fbb1) and will be archived online and available through January 26, 2027. To join via telephone, listeners may dial (201) 389-0879.


A telephonic playback will be available from 12:30 p.m. ET, October 26, 2026, through November 2, 2026. Participants can dial (412) 317-6671 and enter access code 13762848 to hear the playback.


**About Medifast®:**


[Medifast](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmedifastinc.com%2F&esheet=54621996&newsitemid=20261014815135&lan=en-US&anchor=Medifast&index=4&md5=01e84065437536c0008ed5d6f79ceefb) (NYSE: MED) is the metabolic health and wellness company known for its science-backed comprehensive metabolic health system, Trilivy. Designed to help address the challenges of metabolic dysfunction, the company’s holistic approach integrates science-backed plans and products, personal 1:1 coaching, a supportive community, and behavioral science support to develop healthy habits.


Driven to improve metabolic health through advanced science and comprehensive behavioral support, Medifast has introduced Metabolic Synchronization®, a breakthrough science that targets metabolic dysfunction through a comprehensive system focused on fat loss, lean mass preservation, and long-term health. Trilivy’s comprehensive three-part metabolic health system is designed to help people reset their metabolism, refine their health, and renew their lives. By integrating science, coaching, and healthy habits into a single approach, Trilivy helps people look, feel, and live better.


Backed by more than 45 years of clinical heritage, Medifast continues to advance its mission of lifelong transformation through metabolic science and human connectionTM. For more information, visit[Trilivyhealth.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftrilivyhealth.com%2F&esheet=54621996&newsitemid=20261014815135&lan=en-US&anchor=Trilivyhealth.com&index=5&md5=5a5d8c7a624605ef56061ff4df8d6f0e) and[Medifastinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmedifastinc.com%2F&esheet=54621996&newsitemid=20261014815135&lan=en-US&anchor=Medifastinc.com&index=6&md5=2f2e9e9995f47f48cc2a1580711dfa53) .
